hook: Adding one server should not break every cache lookup.
hookText: Adding one server should not break every cache lookup

beats.say: With four servers, hash key modulo N spreads keys evenly, but adding a fifth server changes the remainder for most keys.
In a test with one hundred thousand fake keys, the author found that adding a fifth server makes roughly four out of five lookups miss.
Consistent hashing fixes it with a ring: each server and key gets a spot on a clock face, and a new server only takes the keys next to it.
